\[
g = h * f
\]

The formula shows the default parameter values.

where

- \(f, g\): The image and the blurred image
- \(h\): The point spread function

The image f is convolved with the PSF h. The PSF is the kernel of the Gaussian filter cut at 4 sigma, of the motion blur filter, or of the disk averaging filter. All three are symmetric under a half turn, so convolution and correlation give the same result. Use the same blur settings in a deconvolution filter to undo it.
